articles.title: Users reporting problems with Apple's first foldable iPhone
articles.summary: Owners of Apple's first foldable iPhone have reported problems with the device's screen - just days after the product went on sale.

articles.title: Anthropic reveals plans for blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, the company behind the popular Claude chatbot, has filed papers to sell shares to the public for the first time.

articles.title: Starlink back to 'the level ⁠we need' in Ukraine, Zelenskyy says
articles.summary: The Starlink satellite system is back to operating at the speed Ukraine needs after slowing down for more than a week, damaging Kyiv's ability to defend itself from Russian attacks, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

articles.title: UK pledges £600m to defend against AI health and security threats
articles.summary: The UK has pledged to spend £600m to defend the public against threats to health and security from artificial intelligence.

articles.title: The £1,000 mistake people are making with new iPhone purchase
articles.summary: Apple's new iPhone Duo is the company's first foldable device - but at £1,999, it's not cheap.

articles.title: Mounjaro rollout on NHS needs 'urgent' boost, say MPs
articles.summary: Plans for rolling out weight-loss drug Mounjaro are "unambitious" and will reach a "woefully small number of people", according to MPs.

articles.title: Military aircraft to be equipped to fight wildfires
articles.summary: Military aircraft will be equipped to help tackle wildfires, the UK government has announced, after a summer of "unrelenting" blazes and sustained hot conditions.

articles.title: Vital clues could help predict prostate cancer years in advance
articles.summary: Scientists have found clues that could help predict who will develop aggressive prostate cancer many years in advance.

articles.title: UK 'woefully unprepared' to face wildfires, MPs warn - as UN issues climate target warning
articles.summary: Exceeding a key global climate target is now "imminent and unavoidable", United Nations (UN) scientists have warned.

articles.title: Japan launches mission to Mars to bring back samples from its moon
articles.summary: Japan launched a spacecraft towards Mars in a ground-breaking mission to bring back samples from the largest of the planet's two moons.
